games.name: Deepwoken
games.desc:
>> Deepwoken is a difficult game with permanent character loss. Losing characters is a part of the game that should be expected. <<

In Deepwoken, every story is yours to tell. Though, however short they may be is up to you. Arm yourself with a selection of hundreds of unique abilities. Plunder and forge a vast array of weapons, armor, and equipment. Fight and overcome the odds, clawing your way back from every defeat.

Explore Lumen, a fragmented world that spans hostile waters, bustling towns, ruined sanctuaries, and nightmarish geometries. Delve through a variety of challenging dungeons, and test your might in PvP.

Uncover the mysteries of a dying world with hundreds of characters and an in-game glossary that expands with every new piece of lore uncovered.

Every aspect of your playthrough can be customised with a range of origins, attributes, modifiers, upgrades, and a diverse amount of customisation options. 

---

games.name: [将] Shogun's Reign
games.desc:
⚔️ [将] SHOGUN'S REIGN 🏯

From the fields to the throne, your destiny is yours to claim.

Welcome to [将] Shogun's Reign, a roleplaying and progression experience inspired by the world of Edo-period Japan. This game contains fantasy elements and is not intended to be historically accurate.

🌾 Work the fields. Earn your first Ryō through farming, labor, and humble trades.

🏮 Find your place. Explore bustling towns, mountain villages, shrines, estates, and the dangerous roads that connect them.

⚔️ Rise through society. Build your wealth and reputation, master a profession, serve those above you, or take a more dangerous path toward power.

🏯 Climb the ranks. Become a respected warrior, influential noble, or powerful feudal lord as you compete with others for status and authority.

👑 Claim the Shogunate. At the very top stands one position above all others: Shogun. Gain enough influence, wealth, and power, and the realm itself may one day fall under your rule.

games.name: bridger: WESTERN (CMOON)
games.desc:
Mankind in their expansion west have settled within Ridge. B Valley, a grueling and untouched wilderness rumored to hold an ancient curse. Beasts hunt and forces beyond mortal reach skulk these grounds, their chaos trapped and anchored by those who came long before them.

Your place within the valley is yet to be decided,  whatever path you choose to walk down danger remains a constant.

-Basic Controls-
Q - Quick dash 
W+W - Sprint 
R - Reload (With Weapon)
M1 - Fire (With weapon)
M2 - Aim in (With weapon) 
G - Melee (With weapon)
X - Ocular Prowess 
C - Fists 
F - Block (With fists out)
M - Statistics Menu 
H - Summon/Unsummon horse
N - Ride horse/Dismount

Welcome to Riot City! Escape prison, become a criminal, rob the bank, collect cars and guns, or enforce the law as a cop and arrest criminals!

👮‍♂️ Riot City is the ultimate cops vs prisoners experience on Roblox. Jump into a massive open-world city where every session is a battle between chaos and justice. Start as a prisoner, break out, build your criminal empire, pull off robberies, escape high-speed police chases, and dominate the streets. With 20+ vehicles and 15+ guns to collect, Riot City is packed with action, progression, and deep customization. Build your perfect ride with vehicle upgrades and customization options, expand your arsenal, and battle on either side of the law
